definitions.full: H5447. sebel סֵ֫בֶל noun [masculine] load, burden ; — absolute Neh 4:11 ; Psa 81:7 (enforced burden); construct id. , = burdensome labour (of corvée ) 1Kin 11:28 . — See also סַבָּל .
